$about: The Protected List of `04-ux-flows.md` §7, made machine-readable.
§8: 'The Protected List is executable, or it is not protected.' Rule 1 there is
the one this file exists to enforce — NO MVP ITEM MAY BE MARKED DONE WHILE ITS
PROTECTED ASSERTION IS SKIPPED. Until this file existed there was nothing that
could tell 'covered by a test' apart from 'nobody has looked', which is exactly
the classic failure §8 describes: the feature ships, the test is disabled
'temporarily', and the detail is gone by the time anyone runs a demo.
So every item carries a STATUS and it is checked by scripts/protected-list.test.ts:
covered  — names a test id that must exist in the suite. A typo fails the build.
blocked  — names what blocks it. An empty blocker fails the build.
partial  — the feature exists in part; `missing` lists what does not, in words.
`partial` is deliberately NOT a passing state. It is here so a half-built item
reads as half-built instead of quietly counting as done, and so the gap is a
sentence somebody wrote rather than a silence somebody has to notice.

items.title: The honest go-live board: fifty names, fifty $0, the footnote, and the activity strip
missing: DONE: the board includes a seller with no ledger row at $0 (migration 0017 fixed the join that hid them); the permanent 'The board starts at go-live' footnote; the 'Earnings tracked since' label; and the 'Demo tenant — these numbers are seeded' note. All asserted by honest-board.spec.ts.

DONE: the four ratified per-period empty states (lb.empty.alltime/.today/.week/.month) plus lb.footnote.period_boundary. The four sentences are guarded mechanically by empty-copy.test.ts — a collapse back into one interpolated string fails the build — and board-periods.spec.ts asserts which tab shows the boundary footnote and that the period selector actually changes the board. The empty block hangs off the floor total, not off rows.length, because the roster join means rows is never empty once a tenant has sellers.

Absent: the today activity strip — dials, contacts, appointments set — which is the ONLY number that moves before the first sale. It counts from call.completed on any outcome, so it needs the Aloware module.

CAVEAT, stated rather than hidden: item 1 cannot complete because aloware_number_mapping does not exist, so the collapse is proven against a stubbed setup read, and item 4's granted path is proven against a stubbed Notification object because headless Chromium reports 'denied' whatever the test grants.
DONE earlier: My Day renders its four sections with counts in the header, and the seed is separately tenanted and refuses to run twice.

DONE, and neither was ever recorded as missing: the seed now SPANS ALL FOUR PERIODS and includes ONE REVERSAL, both named by §1529. Every seeded win used to land on now() because stage_move can only stamp now(), so day, week, month and all-time held one identical number and the period selector demonstrated nothing at minute 0:30. The first win of each seller still goes through the real gate; the rest are backdated through ledger_append, anchored to the CURRENT period boundaries in the tenant business timezone rather than to a fixed number of days.
Absent: the seed refuses to DUPLICATE but not to run in a live environment — that needs system_constant, which does not exist.
